page: Vultr voc-m-32c-256gb-3200s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server featuring an AMD EPYC processor with x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is bundled as a 3200 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. There are no GPUs present on this server.

Benchmark results show top-tier performance in stress-ng single-core CPU execution and large-block uncached memory bandwidth, with read speeds reaching 444.47 GB/sec and write speeds at 197.86 GB/sec. Multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth for small cached blocks are strong, placing in the top 25%. The server also demonstrates strong capabilities in software compilation, ray tracing, and cryptography, while database operations, static web serving, and single-threaded compression tasks perform in the average tier.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 and the integrated 3200 GB NVMe SSD, this server offers high resource density for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. This configuration is suitable for memory-optimized databases, software compilation pipelines, and medium-scale text generation workloads.
